decision: DIFFERS -> W1 + W6 (two clauses of ONE sentence). clemson_hgic_1149 states "Dwarf cultivars should be planted or thinned 8 to 9 inches apart, whereas taller 2- to 3-foot zinnia cultivars should be spaced a foot apart." -> in_row [8,12] (dwarf 8-9, tall 12). Today's [9,12] has no page for 9 as a low; UF/IFAS FP623 'spaced 8 to 12 inches apart' agrees. Row: the live page states 'When planting multiple rows of zinnias, space the rows a foot apart.' (the worklist's '12 to 18 inches' sentence is no longer on the page); 'a foot' is read through the promote's IDIOMS table (ruled 2026-10-01) -> row [12,12]. Four prose strings restating 9-12 are re-authored to 8-12.
